implementation.primitive: Replace the two per-byte checksum loops in PngDeflater.Write and WriteStored with the existing Adler32.Append kernel. No new checksum implementation is added. The decoder/shared kernel itself is unchanged.
implementation.proof: The existing kernel accumulates up to4096 bytes before modulo65521; normalized sums bound the largest intermediate to2408052720<UInt32.MaxValue. In each32-byte vector, b increases by32*a plus the descending weighted byte sum, then a by the byte sum. Adjacent weighted pairs peak at16065, avoiding signed16 saturation. Direct existing-kernel proof compares459712 seed/boundary/split cases against the per-byte recurrence with AVX2 on and off. Existing Adler32 and PngDeflater behavior/cancellation/refusal tests remain.
implementation.ownership: No storage, cache, owner, scope, reservation or workspace-capacity change. Borrowed input is neither mutated nor retained. Forward the same cooperative cancellation token; cleanup remains terminal with no dispose-time flush. All allocation/capacity/overlap/refusal/async lifetime contracts remain.
implementation.otherChange: Correct the pre-existing clustering RFC section comment to3.7.2.2 while this production build is already necessary. No clustering behavior or timing changes.

invalidation: Only PNG encoding checksum callers change, across policies/colors/depths and stream/async/limit boundaries. Four representative affected costs replace old observations; other affected costs remain historical. Adler32 code and all decoders, JPEG/WebP, editing/text are unchanged and keep applicable evidence. Regression/package qualification is not full255-path CPU parity.
workflow: One core build perOS reused for focused tests, one PNG16 short/independent confirmation, three other affected shorts and one full/live/scalar/SAME-actual-package batch. Existing tests and14 complete native packet controls reused, no new test/image grid. All cached selectors recovered byte-for-byte and enum-checked; workers/harnesses unchanged. Initial private standalone arithmetic derivation is retained but not integrated; actual adoption reuses the existing production kernel.
next: Largest newly demonstrated current gap is RGBA16 NoCompression2.754x, exact1066552B. Prioritize bulk stored Deflate payload emission over smaller gains. Preserve bit alignment, row/block choice,4096-byte flush/failure prefixes, cancellation, ownership and all canonical packet hashes. One primitive/one narrow stored16 screen, no grid or retuning closed kernels.
